class.name: RTAO
class.brief_description: Real-time GPU BVH ray-traced ambient occlusion node using OpenGL 4.3 compute shaders and a 3D AO texture volume.
class.description: Computes physically-based ray-traced ambient occlusion against scene [MeshInstance], [MultiMeshInstance], and animated skinned [Skeleton] meshes using a two-level GPU BVH (TLAS/BLAS), a real-time camera-centered 3D [Texture3D] macro-occlusion volume, [BakedRTAO] 3D textures, and [LocalRTAO] volumes. Automatically composites depth-aware bilaterally upsampled occlusion onto the active viewport before volumetric fog and 2D UI, or exposes the 2D and 3D textures via [method get_ao_texture] and [method get_ao_volume_texture].

method.name: apply_quality_preset
method.description: Applies a scalability preset ([constant PRESET_LOW], [constant PRESET_MEDIUM], [constant PRESET_HIGH], or [constant PRESET_ULTRA]) across resolution, ray samples, 3D volume density, and denoising settings.

method.name: get_ao_texture
method.description: Returns the RGBA16F screen-space ambient occlusion [Texture] (RGB = tinted AO multiplier, A = linear camera distance, negative for sky).

method.name: get_ao_volume_texture
method.description: Returns the real-time RGBA16F 3D [Texture3D] macro-occlusion volume updated on the GPU (RGB = world-space bent normal, A = scalar AO).

method.name: mark_geometry_dirty
method.description: Marks acceleration structures dirty so BLAS/TLAS buffers are refreshed.

method.name: reset_history
method.description: Clears temporal accumulation history. Call after camera cuts or teleports.
